Detailed Description

template<typename PAYLOAD_ITEM_TYPE, int MAX_PAYLOAD_ITEMS>
class hrvs_sdk::RadarPayloadOutputAbstract< PAYLOAD_ITEM_TYPE, MAX_PAYLOAD_ITEMS >

Abstract class for HRVS ouput messages consisting of header and payload with unknown size.

Template Parameters
PAYLOAD_ITEM_TYPEType of items included in message payload.
MAX_PAYLOAD_ITEMSMax number of payload items, which will be stored. If number of received payload items is higher, ReturnCode::HRVS_SDK_ERROR will be thrown.
